summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The THOR AdaptiveRisk Dynamic ETF (THMR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund seeks capital appreciation by actively managing a portfolio of stocks, fixed income, alternatives, cryptocurrencies, and commodities. The fund uses a proprietary quantitative system called Darwin. THMR was launched on Apr 9, 2026 and is issued by THOR.
